releaseNotes: 1.2.0.10: Lighter on the hub: the Apple TV no longer sends volume or keyboard updates, messages the device doesn't use are skipped before decoding, connection setup is about 3x faster, and Apple TVs connect a few seconds apart after a reboot. After waking the TV, and after any reconnect or hub reboot, Current App shows none until an app actually plays (the Apple TV can report an old paused app at those moments). 1.2.0.9: Back to two helper devices per Apple TV. The one-helper test in 1.2.0.7 showed the Apple TV ends the session when the setup channel closes, so the Helpers setting is gone and any TV still on One reconnects with both helpers on its own. Keeps the (link) and (setup link) names, sleep clearing, the reboot backup and the 1.2.0.8 reconnect fix. 1.2.0.8: A dropped connection could fail with an InterruptedException error in the log and then sit unreconnected for up to 5 minutes, which showed up as app changes arriving 4 to 5 minutes late. Disconnects are now handled separately from the hub's socket thread, and the retry is always scheduled first. 1.2.0.7: Testing one helper device per Apple TV instead of two (new Helpers setting in the app, One by default, Two if a TV keeps dropping). The helper is now named "(link)". Sleeping the TV now clears the current app, title, artist and duration and shows stopped; the home screen still shows the last app, paused. After a hub restart, any Apple TV that didn't reconnect on its own is reconnected a minute later. 1.2.0.6: currentApp now follows the last app that actually played. When an app closes or the TV turns off, the Apple TV can fall back to an older paused app (PBS showing up after watching Channels, for example). That paused app no longer takes over; only an app that starts playing does. If the app you were watching closes completely, it stays shown as stopped. 1.2.0.5: the Apple TV cards on the app page now update live, no page refresh needed. 1.2.0.4: after an update, each Apple TV reconnects on its own (before, it could look connected but stop updating until Reconnect). First beta: Shows which app is playing on each Apple TV and whether it's playing or paused, plus the title when the app shares it, and whether the TV is awake. Separate from Apple TV Integration and doesn't change it. After installing, open Integrations, add Apple TV Now Playing (Beta), and pair each TV with the PIN shown on screen.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Apple TV Now Playing (Beta)
apps.description: Finds and pairs Apple TVs and creates one Now Playing device per TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV Now Playing (Beta)
drivers.description: One device per Apple TV: current app, playback state, title and awake/asleep. Also runs its two hidden helper devices.
